narr: A few rounds of storms impacted the region between the 9th and 11th of June. A combination of a few storm clusters along with scattered activity resulted in isolated damaging winds and localized flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rain caused a portion of Robbins-Wilk road to be washed out near Pleasant Cir. A car drove into the washed out culvert. Additionally, First Hopewell road was flooded between Ray Ln and Gray road.

Heavy rainfall between 3-5 inches fell across central Leake county. The corridor along MS Highway 16 had various levels of flooding. Multiple houses were flooded along Pilgrim Rest road and residents had to be rescued. Additionally, the intersection of Choctaw road and Okahoma Dr was flooded.

Heavy rainfall between 4-7 inches fell and caused flash flooding across much of south Leake County. MS Highway 487 was flooded between Storm and Morgan roads. Multiple roads were flooded in Lena and several businesses were surrounded by flood waters.

Heavy rainfall between 4-7 inches fell and caused flash flooding across norther Scott County. MS Highway 21 was flooded near Damascus road. The Midway community had multiple roads flooded and some water rescues. Parts of MS Highway 483 was also flooded.
